points.description: First blank: states "univariate" (single-variable / simple regression accepted as a clear synonym) for one explanatory variable.
Second blank: states "multivariate" (multiple regression / multivariable accepted as a clear synonym) for more than one explanatory variable.

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each blank correctly filled: univariate first, multivariate second. Clear synonyms such as simple/single regression and multiple regression are accepted. If the two terms are swapped or wrong, that blank gets 0; a blank answer gets 0.
